# issue 4722 -- release matrix, both faces, with per-release controls
# every release runs its OWN dxc.exe over the same six sources
# generated by measure_history.py; commands are echoed below

$ dxc -T ps_6_0 -E main -HV 2021 control-feature-templates.hlsl
$ dxc -T ps_6_0 -E main -HV 2021 -Fo history-tmp.dxo repro.hlsl
$ dxc -T ps_6_0 -E main -HV 2021 -Fo history-tmp.dxo control-template-column-major.hlsl
$ dxc -T ps_6_0 -E main -HV 2021 -Fo history-tmp.dxo control-nontemplate-row-major.hlsl
$ dxc -T ps_6_0 -E main -HV 2021 -Fo history-tmp.dxo control-nontemplate-column-major.hlsl
$ dxc -T ps_6_0 -E main -HV 2021 -Fo history-tmp.dxo repro-explicit-qualifier.hlsl
$ dxc -T ps_6_0 -E main -HV 2021 -Fo history-tmp.dxo control-explicit-qualifier-nontemplate.hlsl

main-debug     (ground truth) yes  | column_major column_major | row_major column_major | REJECTED  ok        | REPRO -- template row==col byte-identical

Columns: 2021 = does control-feature-templates.hlsl compile at all.
  tmpl-row / tmpl-col = orientation emitted for the template-dependent
    matrix when row-major / column-major is requested via #pragma pack_matrix.
  conc-row / conc-col = the same pair with the template removed; these are
    the per-release instrument self-test and must differ.
  qual-tmpl / qual-conc = does `row_major matrix<...>` written directly on the
    member compile (`ok`) or hit the 'can only be used with a matrix type'
    diagnostic (`REJECTED`), with and without the template.
